children: Tesera begins weekly KNTQ buybacks on 20 November 2026. It sets aside 30% of every fee to fund the buybacks, makes the purchases from a public wallet, and holds the tokens it buys in its treasury.

The weekly purchases create a recurring source of buy demand for KNTQ. The amount Tesera can spend each week depends on how much it collects in fees. The announcement does not state Tesera's fee volume.
Our commitment to Elysium hasn't changed.
